text: wait but is that from doing loop cut on edge mode or on face mode because i know there is the loop cut capability on both, but i only ever use face. ?
resolution: Corrected the loop-cut diagnosis for the mode the user actually uses. FACE mode goes through a different native path than the edge-mode ring walk described in req_3075: the host session meshLoopCutFaceBegin/lcPlanes (framework/gpu/3d.zig:2017,1961). The comb math (cuts+offset, equal slabs) IS a faithful port of the old studio's loopCutPositions, but the plane DIRECTIONS were changed: the old studio always cut with explicit WORLD-AXIS planes (loopCutRange axis 0|1|2 — straight by construction); the native session derives directions via the req_2794 heuristic — longest boundary edge of the selection as U, plus sign-aligned AVERAGED NEIGHBOR-FACE normals as the plane normals. On axis-aligned boxes that reproduces world axes; on the user's shapes (transformed cubes bridged with create-face, neighbors facing every which way) the averaged neighbor normal tilts, tilting every plane in the comb → all cuts slanted the same way. The heuristic has already been iterated twice inside req_2794 and still guesses. Told the user: group fixes from solidify/merge do NOT cure this path; the durable fix is topological/parametric cuts (lines parallel to the face's own edge pairs) rather than a third plane-normal heuristic. No code changed.
